newsitem.title: USA: USDA to revise IMPS for fresh pork.
newsitem.headline: USDA to revise IMPS for fresh pork.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said Tuesday it was seeking comments on revising the Institutional Meat Purchase Specifications (IMPS) for fresh pork.

IMPS give standardized descriptions for commercial meat products. USDA said the proposed revisions include changes to facilitate future federal purchase programs for fresh pork products and new items such as pork loin, riblet and leg tip.
It also said the proposed revisions feature a new ordering checklist that will help purchasers list the optional IMPS requirements desired in a contract.
